name: Stone Wall · Death · Lightning
primary: A 5×3 wall at the aim point, across your view at any angle, each column settling on the ground. Look up to raise a gabled tent roof over you instead, 9 wide and 5 long with open ends. Material: magic earth, permanent.
self_description:
A 5×3 wall at the aim point, across your view at any angle, each column settling on the ground. Look up to raise a gabled tent roof over you instead, 9 wide and 5 long with open ends. Material: magic earth, permanent. On you:
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 4.5 s
• Charge 20: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
